citation.authors: Brunvoll SH, Nygaard AB, Ellingjord-Dale M, Holland P et al

cited_by.title: Cod liver oil: vitamin D, vitamin A and colds

record.population: 34,601 adults aged 18 to 75 in Norway not taking daily vitamin D
record.design: Quadruple-blind randomised placebo-controlled trial: 5 mL a day of cod liver oil (10 micrograms vitamin D) or placebo for up to six months in winter
record.finding: Cod liver oil did not reduce the risk of SARS-CoV-2 infection, serious covid-19, or other acute respiratory infections (for example any acute respiratory infection, relative risk 1.04, 95% CI 0.97 to 1.11). Only low-grade side effects were reported.
record.note: Norwegian adults, mostly white; cod liver oil at a low vitamin D dose, so it does not test higher doses or people with dark skin.
